exposure: Sickle cell disease (hemoglobin SS or SC)
cohort: Pregnant women with hemoglobin SS or SC from three university medical centers (n=428).
finding: Pregnancy outcomes in women with sickle cell disease have not significantly changed between 1979-2003 and 2005-2016.
birth_weight: Infants in the study group (2005-2016) were heavier on average by approximately 220 g
